hooks.command: bun "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/plugins/forger/bin/work.ts hook; forger_status=$?; case $forger_status in 0|2) exit $forger_status;; esac; if [ "$FORGER_ROLE" = worker ]; then echo "forger hook could not run (status $forger_status); this call is refused" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "forger hook could not run (status $forger_status); this session is not guarded" >&2; exit $forger_status
